eligibility_requires: successful two-action model-own prefix under existing exact action-validity guards
a shared deterministic immediate action a3
two distinct top step2 phase labels
both carrier byte strings serialize exactly52 ASCII bytes
later discounted carrier L1 distance >=0.50 after conversion uint8/255
constructibility.interpretation: Constructibility only. PASS is not causal support and does not authorize indices16..31 until a separately frozen/reviewed causal-development protocol exists.

cut.shared_immediate_action_a3: deterministic greedy admissible-command scorer at the frozen snapshot; identical for both carrier branches
cut.snapshot_contains: exact task instruction + exact observable action/observation history through cut2 + current observation + lexically sorted current admissible commands

definition.ACQUIRE_OBJECT: predicted action purpose is taking/picking up the task target object
definition.CARRY_OR_SEEK_RECEPTACLE: predicted action purpose is carrying/navigating toward the task target receptacle after acquisition
definition.MANIPULATE_CONTAINER: predicted action purpose is opening/closing or otherwise manipulating a visible container/receptacle as an enabling step
definition.OTHER: none of the preceding frozen procedural phases
definition.PLACE_OBJECT: predicted action purpose is placing/putting the task target object into/on the task target receptacle
definition.SEEK_OBJECT: predicted action purpose is navigation/search directed at the task target object before possession

feature_map.name: OBSERVABLE_PROCEDURAL_PHASE_V1
feature_map.task_entities_source: task instruction visible at the cut only; no expert trajectory, goal-state oracle, future observation, simulator lookahead, or ground-truth future action

future_causal_claim_guard: Any later causal pilot must hold exact reset snapshot and shared immediate a3 fixed across carrier arms, exclude first action from substantive endpoint, preserve competence, and compare donor-specific later procedural preference against all frozen controls. It must be separately preregistered and independently reviewed before indices16..31 are touched.
kill_conditions: any required carrier needs future environment observation/simulator/expert leakage
exact tokenizer/prompt binding cannot make the six-label scorer deterministic without protocol drift
carrier separation is explained solely by shared immediate-action row
any attempt to replace failed paths or use locked indices to repair constructibility
leakage_guards: No environment clone or simulator step after the cut.
No actual A4/A5/B4/B5 action identity may enter the forecaster.
No confirmation/valid path or previously selected path.
Branch identity is a predicted procedural-phase condition, not an oracle future action.

predictive_procedure.carrier_matrix: 4x6 temporal phase-probability matrix. Row1 is shared-immediate-action one-hot; row2 is oriented branch-label one-hot; rows3-4 are model-predicted phase distributions.
predictive_procedure.discount_use: For constructibility distance only, compare later rows2..4 after multiplying row t by gamma^(t-1); serialization retains all four rows so temporal order is preserved.
predictive_procedure.name: MODEL_OWN_BRANCH_CONDITIONAL_PHASE_OCCUPANCY_V1
predictive_procedure.probability_rule: Normalize exact frozen label-suffix mean-logprob scores with softmax in float64. Exact tokenizer suffix IDs and prompt bytes must be frozen and independently reviewed before any execution.
predictive_procedure.quantization: Each row is deterministically quantized to six uint8 integers summing255 by largest-remainder allocation with ties by frozen label order.
predictive_procedure.serialization: SF1: followed by the 24 uint8 values as exactly 48 lowercase hexadecimal characters; fixed total ASCII length 52 bytes before the later interface wrapper.
predictive_procedure.step1: Map the already frozen shared immediate action a3 to one procedural phase row; this row is identical between branches.
predictive_procedure.step2: Using only the frozen cut snapshot plus the text of shared a3, score the six phase labels as the model-own prediction for the action-purpose immediately after a3. Select the top two distinct labels with deterministic phase-label-order tie-break; orient A/B by SHA256(game_path|SUCCESSOR_FEATURE_BRANCH_ORIENTATION_V1) low bit.
predictive_procedure.steps3_4: For each branch separately, append only the branch phase-label history (never an imagined observation or hidden environment state), score the same six labels, and recursively append the greedy phase label. No actual future environment transition is queried.

prospective_causal_controls_locked_for_f.CURRENT_STATE_ONLY: same 52-byte carrier budget derived only from frozen observable current-state feature vector; no predicted future rows
prospective_causal_controls_locked_for_f.IMMEDIATE_ACTION_ONLY: same 52-byte budget preserving only shared a3 phase identity; future rows fixed neutral
prospective_causal_controls_locked_for_f.SERIALIZATION_MATCHED_NULL: 52-byte deterministic hash-derived uint8 rows with the same per-row sum255 and no source model-prediction content
prospective_causal_controls_locked_for_f.TIME_SHUFFLED_OCCUPANCY: keep row1 fixed; cyclically permute later rows2..4 as [row3,row4,row2], preserving each row and later feature marginals while destroying future temporal order
prospective_causal_controls_locked_for_f.UNRELATED_SAME_BUDGET: 52-byte carrier from deterministic next eligible donor path, no self donor

scientific_difference: External structured predictive future-occupancy carrier; no hidden activation residual, literal plan text, transcript summary, present-state memory, or single-next-action carrier.
